verdict.rationale: Connecting to MCP servers is a fair question for LangSmith, since it has a Playground and agent deployment surfaces, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence that LangSmith acts as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence is an official LangSmith MCP server (the server role), which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here; Agent Auth and custom model servers are related but different features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
